shortDescription: Manage the user accounts on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches.

options.name: access_time
options.description: This parameter indicates the time the file's access time should be set to. Should be preserve when no modification is required, YYYYMMDDHHMM.SS when using default time format, or now. Default is None meaning that preserve is the default for state=[file,directory,link,hard] and now is default for state=touch

options.name: aggregate
options.description: The set of username objects to be configured on the remote ICX device. The list entries can either be the username or a hash of username and properties. This argument is mutually exclusive with the C(name) argument.

options.name: check_running_config
options.description: Check running configuration. This can be set as environment variable. Module will use environment variable value(default:False), unless it is overridden, by specifying it as module parameter.

options.name: configured_password
options.description: The password to be configured on the ICX device.

options.name: name
options.description: The username to be configured on the ICX device.

options.name: nopassword
options.description: Defines the username without assigning a password. This will allow the user to login to the system without being authenticated by a password.

options.name: privilege
options.description: The privilege level to be granted to the user

options.name: purge
options.description: If set to true module will remove any previously configured usernames on the device except the current defined set of users.

options.name: state
options.description: Configures the state of the username definition as it relates to the device operational configuration. When set to I(present), the username(s) should be configured in the device active configuration and when set to I(absent) the username(s) should not be in the device active configuration

options.name: update_password
options.description: This  argument will instruct the module when to change the password. When set to C(always), the password will always be updated in the device and when set to C(on_create) the password will be updated only if the username is created.
